|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During battle, may use 2 Force to place an opponent's alien (except [[Jabba]] or a Rep) present with [[Luke (V){{!}}Luke]] on owner's Force Pile (opponent may use or lose 3 Force instead). Immune to attrition < 4 (< 7 if with an alien leader).
|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Master Luke (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The Virtual Block 3 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image shown here both print this text.
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 3 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “[Pilot] 2. During battle, may use 2 Force to place an opponent’s alien (except Jabba or a Rep) present with Luke on owner’s Force Pile (opponent may use or lose 3 Force instead). Immune to attrition < 4 (< 7 if with an alien leader).”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf Virtual Block 3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174313/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Master Luke (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Master Luke (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “on owner’s Force Pile” to “in owner's Force Pile” and writes the [Pilot] icon out as “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots”: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During battle, may use 2 Force to place an opponent's alien (except Jabba or a Rep) present with Luke in owner's Force Pile (opponent may use or lose 3 Force instead). Immune to attrition < 4 (< 7 if with an alien leader).”.<ref name="cl-1230_76-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142208/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>
